text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Summer training camp has begun once again this year!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"To spread my mentor's 'Umamusume First' teachings,
we plan to upload videos of our summer training camp as well."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: There we go! 1st place~♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Finished.
2nd place, huh.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Great! As expected of Gran!
"Team Mile" is dominating in first place deeeath!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"...Her sense of balance is insane.
She was just running across floating islands like it was nothing."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Do your best, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For the first half of the summer camp,
we decided to participate in the 'Summer Walk.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Activities like this "Splash Rec" allow us to combine
light training with refreshment.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Whether you properly refreshed yourself during summer will affect your autumn results. Balance is key.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: For the next 'Tightrope Quiz', I'll make sure to film the whole thing.
choice_data_list: Thank you. Sorry for asking you to handle the work.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
No, not at all! Getting to participate
like this through filming is really fun.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: To begin with, I'm not very good at athletics...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, Rob Roy-senpai,
did you manage to get any usable video footage?"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I'm sure everyone will be able
to see how lovely Gran-san is.
choice_data_list: I'll edit it early, so I'm counting on you for the text!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Curren-senpai told me it's better
not to overthink it when making one."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: I'll go in without any prep!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'll upload videos showing
Gran Alegria's daily life.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
“Question 1!
How many meters tall is London's clock tower?”

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: "0.06 miles!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: "Huh? Wasn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: “――Ah, so I have to give an exact answer down to 0.0601875 miles, huh!”

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"No, Gran, not like that!
They asked in meters, so miles won't cut it!"

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Gran Alegria, do you really use
miles as the unit for everything in your daily life?!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, this is a training camp, right?
Even if we're just goofing off."

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Looks like their policy is stress-free training.
I guess every Trainer does things differently...?

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: Still, they look like they're having a ton of fun together, don't they? It's so heartwarming♡

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Gran-chan's Trainer is always playing along
with her "My Rules," aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Fan D
text_block_list.text: She said it's to deepen her understanding of Grand.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: "Gran-chan, how many personal rules do you have in total~?"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"So this is what the training camp looks like.
I want to see the meals too!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"I'd heard the name 'Summer Walk' before,
but this is the first time I've learned its purpose and effects.
I see now why it has such a huge impact on the autumn races."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: There's quite a variety of reactions!
choice_data_list: I'm glad it seems to have caught your interest!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yes. Spurred on by my mile videos, many people are saying they want to learn more about all sorts of things.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: "Please tell us more about Trainer and your training sessions too!" they say!
choice_data_list: This is spreading in a way I didn't anticipate.
It's spreading in an unexpected way.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "I never expected casual fans to want to learn such technical details about racing."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: This is a happy surprise for us. Let's keep pumping out those videos!
